title: Add sections, typed values and stringify to the INI parser
prompt: The INI parser in this project only reads flat `key = value` lines. Extend it as described in README.md: sections (including dotted nested sections), inline comments, typed values, quoted strings, `key[]` arrays, and a new `stringify` function whose output `parse` reads back to the same object. Existing flat parsing must keep working. Run the tests with `npm test`.
